summary.text: Paul Wacker is the Republican candidate for Iowa State Senate District 25 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Herman Quirmbach.
His campaign website describes him as a retired UPS employee and former farmer who has lobbied at the Iowa Capitol.

paragraphs.text: Paul Wacker's campaign website says he was born and raised in north central Iowa and farmed near Klemme for eight years.
It says he attended North Iowa Community College and Iowa State University and worked for UPS for more than thirty years before retiring.
The site also says he served for more than thirty years as vice president of Do Right Inc., which provides sound and lighting for Christian events.

According to the site, Wacker has spent more than five years advocating at the Capitol in Des Moines for private property rights, pro-life issues, fiscal responsibility, cutting government waste and education.
